description: Classifies multi-root DataAsset JSON files as byte-identical shared contracts, intentional per-root overrides, or root-owned inventory.

override.reason: Each root can expose different evidence types and therefore different valid joins.
Minimum evidence fields follow the asset types enabled in each root.
Templates depend on root-specific backends, fields, and registered asset types.
Scenario anchors target the bundles and evidence available in each root.
Private roots can retain compatibility fields while migrating scenario anchors.

root_owned.reason: Assets describe the data inventory enabled in one environment.
Bundles select environment-specific assets and scenarios.
The catalog is generated from the files present in one root.
The public root owns the canonical multi-root policy.
The ES root owns its backend migration map.
Connectors contain environment endpoints and credential references.
Example batches can demonstrate the deployment mode represented by the root.
The public root owns the schema for its canonical multi-root policy.
Trace profiles follow root-specific asset and template availability.
